problems.text: A refused confirmation still does not print the reasons of the failed gates. The summarize step line is `<op> via <backend>: gate fail, tied none`. The reasons live in `summarize_log`, which is not serialized, and only the label path writes them (into its failure line). The new detail lines carry limitation lines and, for a `stack:` holder, the per-capture figures. So the shim case explains itself, but a failed gate whose reasons name no `stack:` holder (a JVM or Python histogram gate, for example) and whose evidence has only fixed limitation lines adds nothing after `confirm refused`. Decision 4 lists the reasons as 'already printed', which is true for a label only. By reading; the stand-in of the test returns no reasons, so no test covers it. Fix: add one line per failed summary with its reasons when the call is for a confirmation.
The new helper was inserted between `split_shim` and its doc comment. `clear_stale_capture_files` now carries both comments (its first four lines describe `split_shim`), and `split_shim` has none.

Wording, two places. (1) The size limitation says `N processes wrote shim records with stacks`, but N counts the processes left after the tool and identity steps. Seen: a file with three programs, two of them with the count, gives `2 processes wrote shim records with stacks and 2220 (the iteration count) is in the argv of several`. Present since the first fix. (2) The code comment and the VERIFY row say the identity note is 'one line for the whole file'. It is one line per evidence record, for all capture files of the summary (seen: one line each on the four evidence records of the 17-file replay).

Differences from HEAD that remain, all in crafted files and all as the last report states. Chance identity still reads the smaller process (helper `ninja -j 2220`, driver beside a helper with `--port <x>`, x of 1, 2, 3 with that token elsewhere); each now carries the one-line note. Two records of one pid: the last is read. A program whose first argv word is a listed tool name is dropped as a tool, with no line. The closure that takes 'first argv word, else exe' repeats the private `Rec::program` of dumps.rs; the rule itself uses the shared helpers.

Argv words the redactor does not shape still reach the limitation line and `argv_tail`: a secret as its own word (`--token CorrectHorseBatteryStaple`), `Authorization: Bearer <letters only>` given as one word, `cfg[password]=...`, and a word that starts with `=`. These are rules of `Redactor::name` (redact.rs, outside this pass); the cut order is no longer the cause. In shapes mode a `key=N` word is shaped too, so `--seed=2220` shows as a shape while the line says 2220 is in the argv.

A refused confirmation prints the detail of every failed summary, in summarize order, up to 8 lines, once per refused finding; a refused label of the same fixture prints its lines again. Summaries that fail in passing runs too (`non-heap via jvm-thread-dump`) are included. In the jni order the two shim summaries come first, and the second one is cut by the cap.

With FAKE_GATE=fail the stand-in answers `gate: fail` while its ledger record still says `gate: pass`, so the test goes through 'confirm with summarize evidence refused, retry with the trend alone'. A real failed gate ties nothing and makes one confirm call. Both end in the same refused branch, so the assertion on the step after the refusal holds for either.

These two work directories (144 MB and 4 MB) are from my bench runs with `--keep-work`. I left them because I may delete only under my scratch dir; they can be removed, as can 26941 and 29948 of the previous check. Disk was 3062 MB free at the end; the prune script was not needed.
